validity.researcher_notes: The pipeline itself is REAL and its data is correct, but it is very likely mis-parented under the wrong pipeline family. GEM's own wiki article bundles two things that both operator disclosures and the US government's independent dataset treat as SEPARATE NGPL projects: (1) the 'Gulf Coast Southbound'/'Gulf Coast Expansion Project' (GCEP) Phases I-III, an interstate reversal corridor running Chicago, IL -> Agua Dulce Hub/Corpus Christi/Sabine Pass, TX and Henry, LA, built to move Midcontinent/Marcellus/Utica gas SOUTH for LNG export feed, and (2) the 'Lockridge Extension Pipeline' (a.k.a. 'Lockridge to Waha Project'), an entirely-intrastate-Texas project that instead brings Permian-area gas INTO the Waha Hub via 'an extension of its Amarillo system' -- geographically and functionally distinct, with no state-border crossing (EIA: Beg_State TX, End_State TX, Pipeline Type 'Intrastate', vs GCEP's IL->TX interstate reversal). Evidence: (a) Kinder Morgan's own Q3-2020 earnings release (BOE Report, verified live) lists them as two separate line items in the same paragraph -- 'Construction is progressing on NGPL's Gulf Coast Southbound project. The approximately $203 million project ... will increase southbound capacity ... to serve Cheniere's Corpus Christi Liquefaction facility ... Construction is complete on NGPL's approximately $51 million Lockridge to Waha Project ... The project enables NGPL to deliver up to 500,000 Dth/d to the Waha Hub with an extension of its Amarillo system' -- two different projects, two different cost figures, two different purposes, described back-to-back as distinct. (b) EIA's 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects' database (U.S. government, independent of GEM and of Kinder Morgan) carries them as three separate line items across two different sheets: 'NGPL Gulf Coast Southbound Project (Phase II)' and '(Phase III)' (interstate reversal, IL->TX, $145M each, in the current 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects' sheet) versus 'Lockridge Extension Pipeline' (intrastate, TX->TX, $51.6M, 16.84 mi, 30in, 500 MMcf/d, completed 2020-09-28, docket CP19-52, note: 'Bring additional Permian production to Waha hub') in the 'Historical Projects (1996-2020)' sheet. (c) NGPL's own dedicated open-season notice for 'Gulf Coast Expansion Project Phase 3' (pipeline2.kindermorgan.com PDF, one of this row's harvested wiki citations, opened and read in full via pdftotext) describes GCEP Phases 1-3 exclusively as the Illinois/Iowa-to-Gulf-Coast southbound corridor and never mentions Lockridge or Waha at all -- if Lockridge were truly a phase of Gulf Coast Southbound, NGPL's own project-family solicitation document would be the place to expect it, and it is absent. Net: the ProjectID is not a phantom, not a duplicate of another Texas row on the roster (no close match on name/route/specs among the other 44 rows), and not commodity-misclassified (it is unambiguously a natural gas pipeline) -- but filing it as a 'segment' of 'Gulf Coast Southbound Pipeline' overstates a physical/administrative link that the cited sources do not support. Harvested-citation coverage for this row: 7 citations on the wiki page; I opened/read 4 in full (EIA data.php landing page + the EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Jan2021.xlsx it points to, BOE Report, the GCEP Phase 3 open-season PDF) and could NOT read 3 -- rbnenergy.com/node/11661 (HTTP 403, and its Wayback snapshot 429'd from web.archive.org's rate limiter on repeated tries), seekingalpha.com (HTTP 403, paywalled/bot-walled), and the Federal Register CP20-14-000 notice for the '134th Street Lateral Project' (opened and read in full, but it is correctly cited on the wiki page for a DIFFERENT section/segment of the same page -- an Illinois/Indiana lateral, not Lockridge -- so it is irrelevant to this segment rather than unread evidence). None of the three unread sources look load-bearing for Lockridge specifically (RBN Energy and Seeking Alpha's citations on this wiki page are pinned to the Phase I/II background sections, not Lockridge).

BOE Report/KMI: 'Construction is complete on NGPL's approximately $51 million Lockridge to Waha Project ... which was placed in service on September 18, 2020. The project enables NGPL to deliver up to 500,000 Dth/d to the Waha Hub with an extension of its Amarillo system.' Sheet values (Status=operating, Fuel=Gas, StartYear1=2020, Capacity=500.00 MMcf/d, LengthKnown=16.80 mi, Diameter=30 in, Owner1=NGPL 100%) all match. FuelSource=Permian and the TX/TX location are each corroborated by only the EIA note/state field alone (BOE's text for this specific bullet doesn't name Permian or spell out Texas), so those two stay medium tier per the corroboration rule rather than high. The existing SegmentCost [ref] (eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php#pipelines) is a dead/generic landing page that does not itself contain the $51M figure -- verifier correctly failed it; replaced with the BOE Report URL (which states 'approximately $51 million' verbatim) plus the EIA xlsx as a second origin. No duplicate found against the other 44 Texas rows in the roster; no existence or spec discrepancy of any kind.
